race: Formula 1 MSC Cruises United States Grand Prix 2026

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Welcome to the Race Weekend Podcast, and Austin is buzzing because one pole position could end in a world title this weekend before we get there.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Kimi Antonelli has the pole, and the bigger story is that he could become the youngest Formula One world champion on Sunday at Austin.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: He took pole on the weekend he can win the title, and he says he is enjoying himself more than usual, which is a calm warning to the rest of us.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Charles Leclerc was fastest from Antonelli in practice, so Ferrari are not hiding right now, and that makes the top three feel alive.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Max Verstappen has the bumps story, because Austin can get out of control early, and he is the one who thrives in that chaos.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: There are grid penalties too, a ten place drop, a five place drop, and one huge eighty place drop that changes the race early.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: So let us go to the top three, starting with Kimi Antonelli, because this pole feels like a championship moment on the grid.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: I am with you, his confidence is high, and a calm champion candidate is the hardest thing to read on race day for me.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Mercedes has been strong at Austin, and when he is in championship form, that pole is a huge advantage on Sunday on the grid.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: But here is the deep cut, his Austin history is thin, average thirteenth, best thirteenth, and no podium in one race for him.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: That is the quirk I love, because a pole in Austin is a first for him at this track, and that makes it extra spicy for sure.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: If he wins, the history book gets a brand new page, and he can do it before the season is over, and that is the dream for the team.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Now Max Verstappen, second on the grid, and the man who has turned Austin into his own backyard for years.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Three podiums in three races here, best result a win, and his average is almost pole position, so the numbers are scary.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Almost pole position? That is a scary stat, and I am not buying that he will wait for a clean run to happen.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: He has won here before, he knows the bumps, and Red Bull pace is strong, so if he gets the launch, he is the one to beat.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: I am not buying that he will wait for a clean run, because Verstappen will find a way through the bumps.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: That brings us to Charles Leclerc, third on the grid, and the Ferrari that looked quick from Friday, and it was no accident.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: He had the fastest practice from Antonelli, which is a big statement when the pole position is on the line.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Ferrari form is real, his Austin history is strong, two podiums in two races, and he has won here before.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: So the top three is a three way fight, with Kimi on the front, Max right behind, and Charles ready to strike.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: I would add the rest of our top ten, but Paul has the run through, so let him fly and get us to the sign off.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Beyond the top three, Lewis Hamilton starts fifth, George Russell sixth, and the Mercedes cars look like a real threat.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Isack Hadjar is sixth, Lando Norris seventh, Oscar Piastri eighth, and the Red Bull and McLaren pace is hard to ignore.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Liam Lawson is our ninth, and Pierre Gasly completes the top ten, so there is still a real fight for points behind the stars.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: I love that, because a low confidence pick can turn the whole story, and Gasly has the form to make it happen.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Here is our top ten, Kimi Antonelli, Max Verstappen, Charles Leclerc, Lewis Hamilton, George Russell, Isack Hadjar, Lando Norris, Oscar Piastri, Liam Lawson, and Pierre Gasly. Austin, buckle up.
